purpose: Structure multi-provider observability as KuuOS dependent-origination presentation/descent rather than as a provenance graph.

dependent_origination_structure.presentations: Provider-local bounded observations are presentations, not substances.
dependent_origination_structure.conditioning_families: Shared exact-context evidence generates local conditioning relations.
dependent_origination_structure.presentation_relation: The equivalence closure of exact conditioning witnesses forms quotient-like presentation classes.
dependent_origination_structure.local_compatibility: Every pair inside a generated class must be rechecked against bounded temporal semantics.
dependent_origination_structure.descent: A class descends only when all local comparisons are compatible.
dependent_origination_structure.obstruction: A related pair with incompatible local semantics is retained as an explicit descent obstruction.
dependent_origination_structure.held_descent: Missing or transient local semantics hold descent open rather than forcing success or failure.
dependent_origination_structure.local_only: An isolated presentation remains local and is not treated as a global failure.

status_semantics.KUUOS_OBSERVABILITY_DEPENDENT_ORIGINATIO: All generated multi-presentation sectors either descend or remain isolated local presentations.
At least one generated sector has unresolved local semantics, so descent is held open.
At least one generated sector contains an explicit local incompatibility obstruction.
Schema, authority, digest, or input-binding invariant failed.

descent.next: higher compatibility of descended sectors without reifying a global object
